PZZ700-130900-
1243 PM PST Thu Nov 12 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 PM, a 1024 mb high was over Utah and a 963 mb low was 600 
nautical miles west of Seattle at the core of an incoming weather
system. Moderate onshore flow today will become southerly tonight
and Friday, turning westerly and strengthening late Friday into 
Saturday. Swell and wind waves will increase considerably at the 
same time. Hazardous boating conditions are likely Friday into 
Saturday afternoon, and a Small Craft Advisory is in effect. 
Winds and seas diminish late Saturday and Sunday, before
increasing again on Monday as the next weather system arrives. 
Additionally, storms Friday morning will bring gusty and erratic 
winds and a lightning threat for the marine waters. 

$$
